detail.longDescription: As a non-tech person who hangs on by my fingernails at "just beyond consumer-level" tech stuff, I have to say there is an important rule when you're trying to learn something new in this area: Do Not Start With Documents Written By The People Who Made The Thing . Those are useful later. IDK what the fundamental factors are, but I imagine one is that the skills required to build really cool stuff have little overlap with the skills required to explain it to general audiences.
